canonical_name: No Computing Hardware and Software Monitoring
description: Computing hardware and software are not monitored for potentially adverse events.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity detection capabilities Security operations and monitoring teams Threat detection and analysis functions Organizations with continuous monitoring requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Organizations should monitor endpoints, servers, workstations, mobile devices, containers, virtual machines, and their associated software and runtime environments. This includes monitoring for malware, unauthorized changes, configuration drift, vulnerability exploitation, resource consumption anomalies, and data integrity issues that could indicate potentially adverse events.
